capabilities: Log finished timers to Markdown notes.
Export time data to CSV or Toggl/Clockify.
disambiguation: It functions as both a visual timer and a detailed time tracking system for tasks.
problem: Users need a visible, integrated way to track time for tasks and projects directly within their Obsidian notes.

relations.evidence: Task time tracking (bundled Task Time Tracker 0.0.31, MIT)

summary: Compact timers and stopwatches pinned to the top of notes, providing visual time tracking, Markdown time logs, and integrated task time tracking.
